properties.name: camel.cli.transport
properties.description: How the connector talks to the tooling: file (exchanges files in ~/.camel with the Camel CLI) or websocket (dials out to a developer tool over a WebSocket, see camel.cli.websocket).

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.allow-insecure
properties.description: Allow ws:// (unencrypted) to a host that is not a loopback address. Prefer wss:// or a tunnel.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.client
properties.description: The WebSocket client: auto uses the Spring WebSocket client when the application has spring-websocket and a Jakarta WebSocket implementation (such as with spring-boot-starter-websocket), otherwise the JDK client; jdk always uses the JDK client.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.heartbeat-interval
properties.description: How often the connection is checked with a ping, in millis. The connection is re-established when the tool does not answer for three intervals.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.reconnect-delay
properties.description: Delay before reconnecting, in millis. It doubles after each failed attempt (with some random jitter).

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.reconnect-max-delay
properties.description: Maximum delay before reconnecting, in millis.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.snapshot-interval
properties.description: How often snapshots are sent, in millis.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.ssl-bundle
properties.description: The name of an SSL bundle (spring.ssl.bundle) to trust the tool with wss:// when using the Spring WebSocket client.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.token
properties.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer token when connecting. Required unless the URL is a loopback address. Prefer the CAMEL_CLI_WEBSOCKET_TOKEN environment variable to keep it out of the process list.

properties.name: camel.cli.websocket.url
properties.description: The ws:// or wss:// URL of the tool. Required when camel.cli.transport=websocket.
